description: This file contains unit tests for the WakeWords class, testing parsing, sanitization, and change detection functions related to wake word processing.

classes.name: WakeWordsTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying WakeWords utility functions such as parsing and sanitization behavior.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparatedTrimsAndDropsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that comma-separated wake words are correctly trimmed and empty entries are dropped.

methods.name: sanitizeTrimsCapsAndFallsBack
methods.description: Tests sanitization of wake words for trimming, capitalization, length constraints, and fallback to defaults.

methods.name: sanitizeLimitsWordCount
methods.description: Ensures the sanitized list respects the maximum number of words.

methods.name: parseIfChangedSkipsWhenUnchanged
methods.description: Verifies that no change is reported if the input wake words are unchanged.

methods.name: parseIfChangedReturnsUpdatedList
methods.description: Verifies that a new list is returned if wake words have changed.
